Ava (Sales): FYI IonWorks (enterprise health) wants a POC with a custom Llama-variant. They need catalog fit, KV-cache compatibility, KMS/HSM, and a rough pricing estimate for ~100k requests/day (avg 512 tokens). Any immediate red flags?
Priya (SE): Do we have a tokenizer adapter for their custom tokenizer? Also need model metadata: hf config, model type (rmsnorm/ln), and license (commercial ok?). If they use rotary embeddings or a nonstandard attention, that could be a blocker.
Diego (SRE): From infra side: 4-bit quant is fine generally but we need to validate KV cache layout. Some converted weights change KV ordering which breaks continuous batching.
Liam (Runtime Eng): Quick checklist: 1) sample checkpoint (safetensors) + tokenizer files, 2) model card, 3) target sequence length & max concurrency. We can run `redwood model inspect` locally:
```
redwood model inspect --path s3://ionworks-poc/checkpoint.safetensors --show-ops
```
That will print tokenizer + attention type.
Ava (Sales): I'll ask them for a presigned S3 link and the security questionnaire. They also asked for KMS with HSM attestation and EU data residency.
Priya (SE): For catalog onboarding we usually need: weights, tokenizer.json, config.json, sample prompts + eval set (50 prompts), and license. If anything is missing we can create a shim adapter but that takes time.
Diego (SRE): Security note: we support customer-managed KMS and VPC/private deployment (Redwood Private). HSM-backed KMS may require legal + infra approval for the HSM provider; it's not instantaneous.
Liam (Runtime Eng): Performance estimate request: need avg tokens per request (512 provided), QPS pattern (burst vs steady), and latency SLO. For 100k req/day -> ~1.16 req/s average. But concurrency and tail are what matter.
Ava (Sales): They said steady 100k/day with 5x peak bursts during business hours. Latency SLO 300ms p95.
Priya (SE): 300ms p95 for a 30B quantized model is tight on shared hosted. Recommend Dedicated or Private. We can try a canary on Dedicated and if needed offer a burst reserve.
Diego (SRE): Action items: I'll run a KV-cache layout probe once we have the checkpoint (ETA 24h after upload). Liam can run a 10k prompt perf sweep on Dedicated if we get model onboarded.
Liam (Runtime Eng): I'll prep a small perf harness. Priya, can you run a tokenization check and basic forward pass? If it fails we may need an adapter or re-export.
Priya (SE): Yep. I'll do tokenizer + forward pass. If we need to convert, recommend `safetensors + config.json` re-export with HF transformers v4.31 conversion.
Ava (Sales): Pricing ask: do we have a quick ballpark for Dedicated per-hour cost for 30B q4? They want to compare against self-hosting.
Liam (Runtime Eng): Ballpark (very rough): Dedicated steady cluster with capacity for 300 concurrent tokens/s would be lower latency but need exact numbers. I'll run the cost calc once I have perf numbers.
Ava (Sales): Two enterprise blockers called out by their legal: 1) HSM-backed KMS + attestation, 2) EU-only data residency + audit logs. Both flagged as must-haves.
Diego (SRE): Both are supported through Redwood Private / enterprise package; legal + sales need to sign off on HSM vendor. Document request: I'll attach SOC2 cert + architecture note once I validate.
Ava (Sales): OK plan: 1) I request presigned S3 + security questionnaire from IonWorks now, 2) Priya runs tokenization/compat probe on upload, 3) Diego runs KV probe, 4) Liam runs perf/cost calc. Target ETA 48 hours for first round.
Priya (SE): Sounds good. If they want quicker turnaround, ask for a tiny sample checkpoint (1-2 layers) so we can validate tokenizer + attention type immediately.
OpsBot: Reminder: attach any customer PII to a secure ticket. Link to onboarding checklist: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/onboarding/poc-checklist
Ava (Sales): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll ping when presigned link + sec questionnaire arrive.
